title: Quick Energizing Thai Veal Kanom Jeen
description: A cultured and energizing Thai dish featuring veal and toast in a glassy-jelly kanom jeen form, perfect for a quick and raw-friendly meal.
instructions: Cook the glass noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the kanom jeen curry paste over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the sliced veal to the pan and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil and cook for an additional 1 minute.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of toast on a plate and top with a portion of the veal and sauce mixture.
Add a scoop of the cooked glass noodles on top of the veal and serve immediately.
